constraints.name: user_post_puzzles_changed_image_valid
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((mode = 'hidden_object'::text) AND (changed_image_path IS NULL) AND (changed_image_claim IS NULL)) OR ((mode = 'spot_difference'::text) AND (changed_image_path IS NOT NULL) AND ((char_length(changed_image_path) >= 1) AND (char_length(changed_image_path) <= 512)) AND (changed_image_path !~ '(^/|\.\.|\\|[?#])'::text) AND (changed_image_path ~ '\.png$'::text) AND pixieed_valid_image_claim(changed_image_claim))))
